answer: A Verified email inbox bound by DNS record proof with one identity per channel turns a private channel into public evidence: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a prism only after its channel answers the challenge. No glacier is counted twice and no marble is skipped: the ledger reconciles every binding.
